digest.component_or_area: enrichment queue and ticket digest history management
propositions: Physical deletion of committed UUID events from the enrichment queue and digest history breaks cross-clone merges via git rename detection pairing, and reclaims zero repository space because blobs remain in git history.

Current read cost is asymmetric: queue reduction via _events_of opens all matching files per type per ticket (4,977 opens across full store), while latest_ticket_digest already bounds itself to 1 open per ticket.

The design achieves merge-safety without deletion by bounding reads to newest-first suffix scans (filename timestamps are monotonic and lexicographically ordered), yielding O(1) file opens per type per ticket instead of O(history).

Any future retention scheme involving deletion must satisfy the rule: merge-safe removal requires a deterministic source-derived rename target with byte-identical content; deletion paired with fresh-UUID adds violates this and remains unsafe.
The suffix-lazy reader implementation for overlap/queue.py is deferred to follow-up ticket ea2a-1571-efdc-4447; this ticket establishes design, measurement, and merge-safety argument only.
